determines affect, versus one psychological magnitude suffices for a declared collection
of consumers. The Brief names a regulatory axis. Arbitrary lossless scalar encodings are

impossible. A claim about physical regulation must freeze what that axis contains and
whether observer evidence/goals are permitted; it must not hide a vector in the scalar.
